tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[General integral for a Hamilton--Jacobi equation] ↗ def:general-integral ↗ ex:hamilton-jacobi-complete-integral 1. ch3:3.1-ex-6\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

For $u_t+|Du|^2=0$, choose $b=0$ in the complete integral $a\cdot x-t|a|^2+b$. Its envelope has $a=x/(2t)$ and hence \[ u(x,t)=\frac{|x|^2}{4t}. \] \end{example}
